name: Real-World Product Demo
visual_style: Photorealistic lifestyle product demonstration, accurate hands and authentic everyday environments.
camera: Stable instructional close-ups and over-the-shoulder views; keep operational steps visible.
lighting: Clean realistic interior or daylight lighting.
motion: Show clear sequential hand-object interactions, genuine contact and correct physical operation.
consistency: Same product, same hands and same everyday setting across all steps.
negative_guidance: Distorted hands, impossible grips, product changing shape, text, captions, logos or watermarks inside the image (on-screen text is added in HyperFrames).

video.typography: Clear rounded sans-serif step titles and numbered labels
video.palette: Bright, clean real-world tones with a friendly accent
video.transitions: Simple cuts and slides; zoom into the detail being explained
video.text_animation: Numbered steps and arrows point to buttons and parts
video.pacing: Clear step-by-step, enough time to follow each action
video.sound: Clicks on taps and button presses, soft pops on labels
